intake_analysis.case_summary: Amber Bell and Erik Devlin entered into a contract with LLW Construction, represented by Mike Winiarek, for home renovations. After multiple payments totaling $100,000, they encountered significant issues with the quality of work and incomplete tasks. Despite ongoing communication attempts, the contractor has not addressed their concerns. They have incurred additional costs and received notice of a lien from a subcontractor. The clients seek financial recovery for the incomplete work and reimbursement for out-of-pocket expenses.

Compensation for additional costs incurred to correct or complete the work.
key_facts: Issues with work quality began in December 2024.
Received notice of lien from subcontractor.
intake_analysis.financial_impact: Clients have paid $100,000 for incomplete work and incurred additional costs for repairs.
